data.one_liner: Detects user impression events for Flutter widgets.
data.what_it_does: It provides a widget called ImpressionDetector that tracks when a child widget is viewed or impressed by the user, triggering a callback. It is inspired by ImpressionKit and uses visibility_detector underneath.
use_when: You need to track analytics or user behavior when specific widgets appear on screen.
You want a simple wrapper widget to detect when a widget becomes visible.
avoid_when: You need complex state management solutions.
You need an alternative out of the provided catalog that matches this domain (none are listed).
weaknesses: Limited documentation and features mentioned beyond basic usage.
